name: Stumpsquall Hydra
oracle_text: When this creature enters, distribute X +1/+1 counters among it and any number of commanders.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, distribute X +1/+1 counters among it and any number of commanders.

needs.what: A division decision that splits a single pool of N counters (here N = the X paid, via the existing {"x": true} value) across a player-chosen set of objects, each object receiving its own share of at least one and the shares summing to exactly N. The chooser picks both how many objects participate ('any number of commanders', plus the source itself, which is always included) and each object's share, and the shares must be locked in as the ability is put on the stack, since divided counters/damage are chosen at announcement, not on resolution.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `add_counters` is the closest op, but its `amount` is evaluated once and then applied in full to every object returned by `choose_objects` -- so `{"counter": "+1/+1", "amount": {"x": true}, "objects": {...}}` gives X counters to each chosen commander rather than X counters total split among them. `for_each` and `repeat` can iterate, but they multiply the effect per iteration rather than partitioning a fixed pool, and neither offers a per-object amount the player chooses. There is no decision kind in the vocabulary that asks a player to divide a number among targets. The selector side is fine -- `static_filter_keys` already carries `is_commander` and `self_only` -- so the missing piece is purely the divided-amount decision, not the ability to find the objects.
